answer: Sybil resistance combines an exponential temporal half-life with EigenTrust-style factorization: each interaction’s reputation decays continuously, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain weight. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming support; copied endorsements cannot bootstrap it without reciprocal, time-tested paths. Thus a comet, sable, or garden of aliases remains below consensus thresholds.
